title: Server file path disclosed in a response
description: The response body contains a server-side source path (an absolute source path). Absolute paths reveal the deployment layout and framework, which narrows the search for file-based flaws.
remediation: Immediate: stop returning absolute paths in error text; log the full path server-side and return a relative name and a correlation id to the client. Durable: centralise error rendering so every handler uses the same sanitiser, and add a test that greps error responses for the deployment root. Trade-off: a correlation id is less convenient for a developer reading a bug report, but the full path stays available in the log entry the id points at.
limitation: Pattern on one body: a Windows or Unix path in a download link or log excerpt can match.
